ec2_usd_per_hour.source: eu-west-2 (London) on-demand, from third-party aggregators (doit.com, devzero.io); to be confirmed on AWS's price list

notes: All prices in GBP, excluding VAT. No payment is taken on the site: the order is emailed to agent@riskmandate.ai and we reply with a quote.

Token mix (editable): 75% cache reads, 20% fresh input, 5% output. That blends to $1.05 per million tokens on Sonnet 5.5, $1.95 on Opus 5.5, $0.05 on Haiku 5.5 (Haiku cache reads assumed at $0.01) and $4.69 on Fable 5.1.
Token budgets are Sonnet-equivalent: 1M on Sonnet 5.5 = 0.5M on Opus 5.5 = 10M on Haiku 5.5 (half the cost-equivalent 20M, because Haiku's cache price is not listed). Fable 5.1 on request.
We add 25% on top of the workers' tokens for the queen and the host session (not yet measured).
Measured on our own runs (15 Oct 2026): 75k to 151k tokens per worker, 325k to 541k per run with 3 to 6 workers, 17 to 21 minutes per run; studio run 1 used 629,857 tokens across 7 builders.
Runs are not automated end to end yet: a person on our side starts, watches and hands over every run. Prices cover that person's time at an assumed £75 an hour.
Margin target 40%, floor 35%. The arithmetic behind every price is in out/ruv-sgit/r5-market/economist/economics.md.

groups.title: Task runs
groups.summary: A Ruflo queen and a team of agent workers do one task on our shared infrastructure, inside an sgit vault, under an Agent Behaviour Policy with no internet access. You get the vault back.
groups.who: Anyone with a well-defined task and the materials for it: consultants, teams trying ruv.sgit, people who want the audit trail as much as the result.

items.name: Small run
items.summary: A queen and up to 5 workers for a focused task.
details: 1 queen + up to 5 workers in parallel
Up to 1M tokens on Sonnet 5.5, or 0.5M on Opus 5.5, or 10M on Haiku 5.5
Stops at 15 minutes of wall-clock time
Materials up to 50 MB, uploaded by you
No network access: the run's behaviour policy allows no egress
You get the run's sgit vault: every brief, message, delivery, decision and the run ledger entry, as a zip or published with a read key
If a cap is reached the run stops; the vault holds everything done until then

choices.label: Bring your own key (tokens billed to your account)
Vault published with a read key (cannot be undone)
